title: Order lifecycle overhaul
subtitle: Scene gallery: state and Mermaid scenes

scenes.title: Order
scenes.narration: Orders now start as pending instead of paid. Payment moves them to paid, a twenty four hour timeout cancels them, and the old refunded state is gone.

scenes.title: Release timeline
scenes.narration: For anything the built-in scenes do not cover, the storyboard can fall back to a Mermaid diagram, like this rollout timeline.
